article_content: 'After her loss to Serena Williams in the Australian Open final, Maria Sharapova is preparing for her debut at the Mexican Open. Sharapova, who lost in straight sets to Williams in Melbourne, arrived in Acapulco on Friday and is considered a strong contender for the title.  The world No. 2 hopes to move past her 16th consecutive defeat against Williams. Sharapova has been enjoying Acapulco ahead of her first match on Monday. She spent time with young tennis fans in the city.  As the top seed and only top-10 player in the draw, Sharapova is favored to win.  Sara Errani, the 2012 and 2013 Mexican Open champion, is seen as her most likely challenger following a strong showing at the Rio Open. Other seeded players include Caroline Garcia, Irina-Camelia Begu, Timea Bacsinszky, Roberta Vinci, Sloane Stephens, and Madison Brengle. The WTA International event begins on Monday.'

article_content: Editor's note: Reza Sayah is one of the few Western journalists reporting from Tehran after the Iranian government placed restrictions on coverage.  TEHRAN, Iran (CNN) -- Supporters sang tributes as they waited. Upon Khamenei's arrival, they rose and chanted, 'Praise be to God and his prophet, Mohammed.'  Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's Supreme Leader, addressed the crowd at Tehran University during Friday prayers. Holding notes in his left hand, he leaned on the lectern with his right arm, injured in a 1981 assassination attempt. He aimed to quell the week-long unrest. He began with a sermon on unity, invoking Islamic principles. Then, his tone shifted, directly addressing the political situation. He commended the high voter turnout but condemned the post-election turmoil, attributing it to foreign interference from the U.S., Israel, and Britain. 'The enemies aim to undermine our confidence and sow doubt about the election,' Khamenei stated.  An hour into his address, he delivered a blow to opposition candidate Mir Hossein Moussavi's supporters, questioning the possibility of rigging given the 11 million vote difference. He affirmed President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad's victory, calling him 'the absolute victor.'  Khamenei warned those challenging the results: 'If political elites disregard the law and take harmful measures, they will be held accountable for the resulting violence and unrest.' The crowd, largely Ahmadinejad supporters, repeatedly chanted 'Death to America!' and 'Death to Israel.'  Moussavi, who had called for a recount, was notably absent, as were his supporters. The streets, usually filled with protesters, were quiet. The attendees at Friday prayers, mostly religious conservatives, contrasted sharply with the demonstrators.  Some in the crowd called for unity, while others issued stern warnings against further protests. The potential consequences of continued demonstrations loomed, with further protests expected the following day. Khamenei's message was clear: the unrest must end.

テヘラン、イラン（CNN）―― 支持者たちは待っている間、賛辞の歌を歌っていました。ハメネイ師が到着すると、彼らは立ち上がり、「神とその預言者ムハンマドに称賛あれ」と唱えました。

イランの最高指導者、アヤトラ・アリー・ハメネイ師は金曜礼拝でテヘラン大学において群衆に向けて演説しました。左手にメモを持ち、1981年の暗殺未遂で負傷した右腕で演台に寄りかかりました。彼は一週間続いた騒乱を鎮圧しようとしていました。

彼はまずイスラム教の教えに基づき、結束の大切さについて説教しました。その後、語調を変え、直接政治情勢について語りかけました。高い投票率を称賛しましたが、選挙後の混乱はアメリカ、イスラエル、イギリスからの外国勢力の干渉によるものだと非難しました。「敵は我々の自信を揺るがし、選挙に疑念を抱かせようとしている」とハメネイ師は述べました。

演説が始まって1時間後、彼は野党候補ミル・ホセイン・ムーサヴィー氏の支持者にとって受け入れがたい評決を下しました。1100万票もの差があるのに不正操作などあり得るのか、と疑問を呈しました。マフムード・アフマディネジャド大統領を「絶対的な勝利者」だと断言しました。

ハメネイ師は選挙結果に異議を唱える者たちに警告しました。「政治家やエリートが法律を無視し、有害な行動をとれば、その結果として生じる暴力や流血、騒乱の責任を負うことになるだろう」。

群衆はアフマディネジャド支持者がほとんどで、「アメリカに死を！」「イスラエルに死を！」と繰り返し唱えました。

再集計を求めていたムーサヴィー氏と彼の支持者は、この金曜礼拝には姿を見せませんでした。普段は抗議者で溢れかえっている通りも静まり返っていました。金曜礼拝に集まった人々は、ほとんどが宗教的な保守派であり、デモ参加者とは対照的でした。

群衆の中には融和的な人もいて、「国民は団結すべきだ。我々は皆一つだ」と述べていました。一方、強硬な姿勢をとる人もおり、「デモを止めなければ、 consequences があるだろう」と警告を発していました。

まさにその consequences とは何かは、デモ隊が再びテヘランの通りに繰り出すと予想される土曜日の午後に明らかになるかもしれません。しかし今のところ、イランの最高指導者は明確に警告を発しました。もうたくさんだ、と。

article_content: According to a Centers for Disease Control report, flavored tobacco use, particularly in 'little cigars,' may be increasing among teens.  Two-fifths of middle and high school student smokers report using flavored little cigars or cigarettes.  Alarmingly, about 60% of those who smoke flavored cigars don't intend to quit, compared to 49% of all cigar smokers. Smoking remains the leading cause of preventable death and disease in the U.S. This report, utilizing data from the 2011 National Youth Tobacco Survey, marks the CDC's first attempt to quantify flavored little cigar and cigarette use among youth. Dr. Tim McAfee, director of the CDC's Office on Smoking and Health, notes that flavors can mask the harshness of tobacco, making it more appealing to new smokers.  Cigar sales rose 240% between 1997 and 2007, with flavored cigars accounting for 80% of sales.  Most adult smokers (88%) report starting before age 18.  While overall youth tobacco use has declined, little cigar use remains a concern. In 2009, the Family Smoking Prevention and Control Act banned flavored cigarettes, but not flavored cigars. These 'little cigars' closely resemble cigarettes in size and shape, having filters, but are wrapped in tobacco leaf, unlike cigarettes.  Often taxed at a lower rate and sold individually, they are more affordable for kids. Rep. Harry Waxman urged the FDA in 2012 to address this loophole, citing tobacco company documents indicating targeted marketing of flavored cigars to youth.  Mark Smith, a spokesman for Commonwealth-Altadis, a flavored cigar manufacturer, stated their products are for adults and they don't market to youth, emphasizing their support for age verification programs.
translated_content: 疾病管理予防センター（CDC）の報告によると、風味付きタバコ、特に「リトルシガー」の使用が10代の若者の間で増加している可能性があります。中学生と高校生の喫煙者の5人に2人が、風味付きのリトルシガーまたは紙巻きたばこを使用していると報告しています。憂慮すべきことに、風味付きの葉巻を吸う人の約60％は、葉巻喫煙者全体の49％と比較して、すぐには禁煙する予定はないと述べています。喫煙は依然として米国で予防可能な病気と死亡の主な原因です。2011年の全国青少年タバコ調査のデータを使用したこの報告書は、CDCが若者の間での風味付きリトルシガーと紙巻きたばこの使用量を定量化しようとした最初の試みです。CDCの喫煙と健康に関する事務所の所長であるティム・マカフィー博士は、フレーバーはタバコの刺激と味を和らげ、特に喫煙に慣れていない人にとって魅力的になると述べています。葉巻の売上高は1997年から2007年にかけて240％増加し、風味付き葉巻が売上の80％を占めています。成人の喫煙者のほとんど（88％）は18歳より前に喫煙を始めると報告しています。若者のタバコ使用全体は減少していますが、リトルシガーの使用は依然として懸念事項です。2009年に、家族喫煙予防管理法は風味付きの紙巻きたばこの販売を禁止しましたが、風味付きの葉巻は禁止していませんでした。これらの「リトルシガー」は、サイズと形状が紙巻きたばこと非常によく似ており、フィルターも付いていますが、紙巻きたばことは異なり、タバコの葉で包まれています。税率が低く、個別に販売されていることが多いため、子供にとってより手頃な価格です。ハリー・ワックスマン議員は2012年にFDA（食品医薬品局）に対し、若者を対象とした風味付き葉巻のマーケティングを示唆するタバコ会社の内部文書を引用して、この抜け穴に対処するよう促しました。風味付き葉巻メーカーであるCommonwealth-Altadisの広報担当者であるマーク・スミス氏は、自社の製品は大人向けであり、若者を対象とした販売は行っていないと述べ、年齢確認プログラムへの支持を強調しました。

article_content: 'Two former aides appointed by Chris Christie have spoken with federal prosecutors regarding the 'Bridgegate' incident, reigniting the controversy weeks after a report seemingly exonerated the New Jersey governor.  According to reports from Esquire and Main Justice, David Wildstein, a former Port Authority official, and Charlie McKenna, Christie's former chief counsel, are attempting to separate themselves from the scandal. U.S. Attorney Paul Fishman, who succeeded Christie in that role, has started presenting evidence to a grand jury, with Christie's press secretary, Michael Drewniak, involved in the proceedings. Wildstein admitted to ordering the lane closures on the George Washington Bridge, seemingly to retaliate against a Democratic mayor who didn't endorse Christie's re-election.  Wildstein alleges he informed Christie about the closures during a 9/11 memorial service, a claim Christie denies. Wildstein recently met with prosecutors.  McKenna, Christie's chief legal advisor during the time of the incident, potentially has knowledge about the governor's office's involvement in coordinating the responses of officials linked to the scandal.  Wildstein and Bridget Kelly, Christie's fired deputy chief of staff, were involved in the incriminating email exchange that initiated the investigation.  Both have refused to testify without immunity.  Similarly, Bill Baroni, another Port Authority official, initially maintained the 'traffic study' narrative before resigning. As Christie prepares for a potential 2016 presidential run, his former aides may be seeking deals with the government.  Wildstein's cooperation suggests this possibility. Fishman, Christie's successor, reportedly has a strained relationship with the governor, stemming from past professional interactions.'

article_content: 'Thirty-year-old accountant Dara Lee Watson went missing on Friday, with her fiance, David Hedrick, reporting her absence to authorities. Hedrick, 34, was later found dead in their Mount Pleasant, South Carolina home from a self-inflicted gunshot wound. Hours before his death, witnesses identified Hedrick leaving the woods where Watson's burnt-out SUV was discovered. While text messages were received from Watson's phone on February 8th, investigators suspect Hedrick sent them. The last confirmed sighting of Watson was by her mother on February 6th. A search of the Francis Marion National Forest involving over 100 officers and Watson's family yielded no further clues. Although a patch of disturbed earth was found about ten miles from the SUV, police believe it's unrelated to Watson's disappearance. Currently, the police are treating this as a missing person case.'

article_content: The holiday travel rush is on! This week marks the start of the Christmas holiday travel period, with many children off school and joining families worldwide.  As many as 116,700 passengers are expected to depart from London's Heathrow Airport on Friday, December 19th, with 698,438 departing over the following five days.  65% of Heathrow passengers during this period will be visiting family and friends, nearly double the usual percentage. Across the UK, over five million travelers will fly in the next seven days for the festive season.  To visualize this, Heathrow created an animation showing passenger movement from the UK in the week leading up to Christmas, including Santa's journey on Christmas Eve. Over the next week, 43,405 flights will depart and arrive from UK airports, 22% from Heathrow, mainly to long-haul destinations. Heathrow's Chief Operating Officer, Normand Boivin, stated, 'Heathrow is proud to connect passengers worldwide for the festive season. This is a busy and exciting time, and the visualization captures our global service.  As a special treat, on Christmas Day, we'll offer festive flyers specially created boiled sweets in three flavors: turkey, sage and onion stuffing, and Christmas pudding.'

article_content: Cristiano Ronaldo has an uncommon extra bone in his ankle, a condition affecting only 10% of people. This was discovered during a medical examination. While playing for Real Madrid, he suffered an ankle injury in 2009. This detail is revealed in 'CR7 - The Secrets of the Machine,' a new book by Luis Miguel Pereira, serialized in The Sun. Ronaldo's dedication to fitness is well-documented. He was once caught using Sporting Lisbon's gym late at night without permission, striving for peak condition. A security report noted that Ronaldo and Jose Semedo were found in the gym at 11:30 pm. Youth coach Luis Martins cautioned Ronaldo against overtraining. Ronaldo's exceptional physical attributes and relentless pursuit of fitness have contributed to his success. article_content: 'The Black Diamond apple, priced at Rs 500 per piece, is a rare, dark-hued fruit cultivated exclusively in the mountainous region of Nyingchi, Tibet, China. Its distinctive deep violet color results from the unique growing conditions: intense ultraviolet light exposure during the day and significant temperature variations between warm days and cool nights.  Unlike typical apple trees, the Black Diamond apple requires eight years to reach maturity, adding to its premium price. This extended maturation period, coupled with the challenges of farming in steep mountain terrain, contributes to its limited availability. While most apples are red, green, or yellow, the Black Diamond apple develops its deep purple, almost black, hue due to the specific geographical conditions of Nyingchi.  High cultivation costs further restrict local access to this unique fruit, and rigorous quality control ensures only the finest specimens reach the market.  Social media users expressed interest, with comments like, 'I hope to try this rare apple one day,' and 'The color is amazing.' Some even speculated, 'The darker the apple, the sweeter the juice.'
translated_content: 'ブラックダイヤモンドアップルは、1個あたり500ルピーという高値で、中国チベットのニンチー山岳地帯でのみ栽培されている珍しい濃い色の果物です。その独特の濃い紫色は、日中の強い紫外線と、暖かい日中と涼しい夜間の間の大きな気温差というユニークな生育条件によるものです。一般的なリンゴの木とは異なり、ブラックダイヤモンドアップルは成熟するまでに8年かかり、これが高価格の一因となっています。この長い成熟期間と、険しい山岳地帯での栽培の難しさにより、入手できる量は限られています。ほとんどのリンゴは赤、緑、または黄色ですが、ブラックダイヤモンドアップルはニンチー特有の地理的条件により、濃い紫色、ほぼ黒に近い色合いになります。高い栽培コストも地元の人々がこのユニークな果物を入手することを難しくしており、厳格な品質管理により、市場に出回るのは最高級のものだけです。ソーシャルメディアのユーザーは、'いつかこの珍しいリンゴを食べてみたい'、'色が素晴らしい'などのコメントで関心を示しました。中には、'リンゴの色が濃いほど果汁が甘い'と推測する人もいました。'

article_content: 'A UN investigation reveals the Middle East faces a looming wider sectarian conflict encompassing Iraq and Syria. Radical Islamist insurgents, identified as ISIS, are perpetrating brutal acts like abductions, torture, and killings targeting civilians and security personnel. UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon voices deep concern over Iraq's declining stability and reports of mass executions. These atrocities coincide with ISIS's attempts to connect territories it holds across the Iraq-Syria border.  A disturbing video purportedly depicts ISIS systematically executing numerous prisoners in Syria.  The UN asserts that ISIS-allied forces have likely committed war crimes, executing hundreds of Iraqi non-combatants in recent days. ISIS's objective is a caliphate governed by strict Sunni Muslim doctrines, opposing both Iraqi and Syrian governments. The group labels Shiites as heretics and has claimed responsibility for slaughtering hundreds of surrendered Iraqi soldiers. Ban Ki-moon stresses the substantial risk of amplified sectarian violence extending beyond Iraq.  He implores Iraqi leaders to deter reprisals and jointly avert further conflict.  Ban Ki-moon has also advocated for a more inclusive approach from the Iraqi government, emphasizing the importance of peaceful coexistence among Sunnis, Shiites, and Kurds. He hopes international support can help restore stability in Iraq.  He further warns that countries tolerating human rights violations become fertile ground for extremism and terrorism.  An international law expert involved in the UN inquiry, Vitit Muntarbhorn, cautions about the potential for a regional war.  UN human rights chief Navi Pillay confirms the likelihood of war crimes committed by ISIS-aligned forces in northern Iraq. A UN report presented highlights the influx of foreign Sunni jihadi militants and funds into Syria, where rebel groups, including ISIS, are abusing civilians. The report underscores the increasing threat of a regional war, noting ISIS's targeting of various communities in Syria, including Shiites, Alawites, Christians, Armenians, Druze, and Kurds, and also Sunni women who they force to follow strict religious laws.'
translated_content: '国連の調査によると、中東はイラクとシリアを含むより広範な宗派間の紛争の危機に瀕しています。ISISと呼ばれる過激派イスラム主義の反乱軍は、民間人や治安部隊を標的とした拉致、拷問、殺害などの残虐行為を行っています。潘基文国連事務総長は、イラクの急速に悪化する治安状況と、大量処刑の報告に深い懸念を表明しています。これらの残虐行為は、ISISがイラクとシリアの国境を越えて支配地域を繋げようとする試みと同時に発生しています。シリアでISISの戦闘員が多数の囚人を組織的に処刑している様子を映したとされる不穏な動画が登場しました。国連は、ISISと同盟を結んだ部隊が戦争犯罪を犯し、ここ数日間で数百人のイラクの非戦闘員を処刑した可能性が極めて高いと主張しています。ISISの目的は、厳格なスンニ派イスラム教の教義に基づくカリフ制の樹立であり、イラクとシリアの両政府と敵対しています。このグループはシーア派を異端者とみなし、先週降伏した数百人のイラク兵士の虐殺を誇っています。潘基文事務総長は、イラク国内外で大規模な宗派間暴力がさらに激化する深刻なリスクがあると強調しています。彼はイラクの政治、軍事、宗教、地域社会の指導者全員に対し、「支持者が報復行為を避けるようにする」こと、そして共にさらなる紛争を防ぐことを強く求めました。潘基文氏はまた、イラク政府に対し、スンニ派、シーア派、クルド人の平和共存の重要性を強調し、より包括的なアプローチを取るよう促しています。彼は、地域諸国と国際社会の強力な支援により、イラク政府が自国の平和と安定を回復できるよう支援できると期待しています。彼はさらに、人権侵害を許容する国々は「過激主義とテロリズムの温床」になると警告しています。国連調査に参加した国際法専門家のヴィティット・ムンタルボーン氏は、地域戦争に発展する可能性について警告しています。国連人権高等弁務官のナビ・ピレイ氏は、イラク北部でISISと同盟を結んだ部隊が数百人の非戦闘員の男性を処刑したことは、ほぼ確実に戦争犯罪にあたると述べています。提示された国連報告書は、外国人スンニ派ジハード戦闘員と資金がシリアに流入していることを強調しており、そこではISISを含む反政府勢力が支配地域で民間人を虐待しています。報告書は、中東における地域戦争の危険性が高まっていることを強調し、ISISがシリアのシーア派、アラウィー派、キリスト教徒、アルメニア人、ドゥルーズ派、クルド人を含む様々なコミュニティ、そしてシャリーア（イスラム宗教法）の遵守を強制されているスンニ派女性を標的にしていることに言及しています。'

article_content: 'A 2013 German television documentary revealed that Amazon employed a security firm, HESS Security, accused of having neo-Nazi connections, to oversee its foreign temporary workforce.  HESS Security guards, sporting military haircuts and clothing from the far-right brand Thor Steinar, allegedly intimidated and harassed workers housed in budget accommodations.  The documentary, aired on ARD, showcased these guards searching rooms and even frisking workers for food.  Amazon responded by promptly terminating its contract with HESS Security, stating its zero-tolerance policy for discrimination and intimidation.  The temporary workers, brought in from across Europe for seasonal work, were reportedly subjected to these unsettling practices.  HESS Security denied the allegations, claiming a diverse workforce.  However, ARD further alleged that the company’s name was a nod to Rudolf Hess, a prominent Nazi figure.  This incident highlighted the vulnerable position of temporary workers, often subject to unfair treatment due to their easily terminated contracts.'
translated_content: '2013年のドイツのテレビドキュメンタリーで、Amazonがネオナチとの繋がりを持つとされる警備会社HESS Securityを雇用し、外国人臨時従業員の管理をさせていたことが明らかになった。ミリタリー風の髪型をし、極右ブランドThor Steinarの服を着たHESS Securityの警備員は、格安の宿泊施設に住む労働者を脅迫し、嫌がらせをしていたとされる。ARDで放映されたこのドキュメンタリーでは、警備員が部屋を捜索したり、労働者の食料を検査したりする様子が映し出されていた。AmazonはHESS Securityとの契約を即時解除し、差別や脅迫に対して一切容認しないとの声明を発表した。ヨーロッパ各地から季節労働のために連れてこられた臨時従業員は、こうした不穏な慣行の対象となっていたと報じられている。HESS Securityは疑惑を否定し、従業員の多様性を主張した。しかし、ARDはさらに、同社の名前が著名なナチス人物であるルドルフ・ヘスにちなんでいると主張した。この事件は、簡単に契約を解除されるために不当な扱いをされやすい臨時従業員の脆弱な立場を浮き彫りにした。'
